desc: Must: make the A3 lifecycle portable variants (TestOracleAssessBlockedVariants, TestOracleUnblockTaskVariants) independent of the Git version and launchable on Windows, with no assertion lost
done_when: On Linux with Git 2.43 all five validation commands pass. rebase-on-refusal-conflict opts into a normaliser that replaces only the Git-produced rebase transcript after 'rebase conflict: ' on state golden lines 132 and 157 with one token, after asserting CONFLICT/could not apply and README in the raw text; the golden diff touches only those remainders. newEnvironment uses oracle.ChildEnv and a GOOS layout: Linux/macOS keep the git symlink, Windows installs a stdlib-only git.exe forwarding shim (sidecar host Git path outside PATH, no PATH lookup); the PATH dir holds one entry. Regressions R1-R5 (Windows layout extension, shim argv/stdin/exit/cwd/env fidelity with negative controls, scenario equivalence through the shim, normaliser variant and negative controls, environment names) pass and their recorded pre-correction runs fail. Neither driver gains a skip, build constraint or TestMain guard; proof-scope.md names both as portable; no production, other driver/fixture/golden, PROVENANCE or harness code change.
scope: IN: internal/oracle/a3/lifecycle env_test.go, fixture_test.go, case_test.go, mask_test.go, unblock_task_variants_test.go (opt-in on one case), new testdata/gitshim/main.go, new regression *_test.go files, testdata/golden/state/unblock-task/rebase-on-refusal-conflict.txt lines 132 and 157; internal/testhelpers/oracle/proof-scope.md a3/lifecycle row and all-platform entry; acceptance manifest specs/plans/20261023-architecture-consolidation/acceptance/arm-1-ar-12-cp-2-d49-portability-lifecycle.json. OUT: production code; conventions_test.go and other drivers, fixtures, goldens; internal/testhelpers/oracle Go code; internal/oracle/PROVENANCE; .github; platform skips or build constraints; .cmd/.bat shims; -race; A2 files; the internal/agent Windows timing test.
